CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_MaritalStatus_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS MaritalStatusId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS MaritalStatusName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'MARITAL_STATUS'
WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
MaritalStatusId
,MaritalStatusName
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId

)) HASHROW, MaritalStatusId,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
MaritalStatusId
,MaritalStatusName
,FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId

)) HASHROW, MaritalStatusId, FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId
FROM BNKM.MaritalStatus --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.MaritalStatusId,TGT.MaritalStatusId) AS MaritalStatusId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CategoryId,TGT.CategoryId) AS CategoryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.MaritalStatusId = TGT.MaritalStatusId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 MaritalStatusId = SRC.MaritalStatusId
,MaritalStatusName = SRC.MaritalStatusName
,MaritalStatusDescription = NULL
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId
FROM BNKM.MaritalStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.MaritalStatusId = TGT.MaritalStatusId AND DELTA.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus SRC ON SRC.MaritalStatusId = TGT.MaritalStatusId AND SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.MaritalStatus
([MaritalStatusId]
,[MaritalStatusName]
,[MaritalStatusDescription]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     MaritalStatusId AS MaritalStatusId
    ,MaritalStatusName AS MaritalStatusName
    ,NULL AS MaritalStatusDescription
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_MaritalStatus_DELTA;

END
